mechanism: Everolimus is metabolized by CYP3A4 and progesterone may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing everolimus levels; additionally, both agents have immunosuppressive and antiproliferative properties.
action: Monitor everolimus levels closely if progesterone is initiated or discontinued; assess for increased everolimus toxicity (stomatitis, infections, myelosuppression); dose adjustment may be necessary.
